name: Staff of the Python

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a Cleric, Druid, or Warlock

powers.name: Become a Snake
powers.text: Magic action: throw the staff to a space within 10 ft; it becomes a Giant Constrictor Snake under your command. A Bonus Action turns it back (it heals). If the snake dies, the staff is destroyed.

summary: Throw it down and it becomes a Giant Constrictor Snake that obeys you.
text: You can take a Magic action to throw this staff so that it lands in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you, where it becomes a Giant Constrictor Snake. The snake is under your control and acts on its own Initiative count. On your turn, you can mentally command the snake if it is within 60 feet of you and you don't have the Incapacitated condition. You decide what action the snake takes and where it moves during its next turn, or you can issue it a general command. As a Bonus Action, you can return the staff to its normal form in a space formerly occupied by the snake. If the snake is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it dies and reverts to its staff form; the staff then shatters and is destroyed. If the snake reverts to staff form before losing all its Hit Points, it regains all of them.
